The *Bhogasaṁharaṇapetavatthu* (Pv 49) is a narrative poem preserved in the *Petavatthu*, situated in the later stratum of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Titled "Accumulation of Wealth" in modern translation, the text centers on the karmic retribution that befalls those who acquire their property and riches through unethical or unwholesome means [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records four translations of the text across four languages [SuttaCentral].
